200.description: One page of the requested set of process flows

schema.description: One keyset page of process flows (REST guideline section 3.3), ordered by flowId (the unique key).

pathId.description: An ACTIVE process path of this service's own catalogue.

processType.description: The kind of work the stage performs (the task types fulfillment-execution publishes).

version.description: Starts at 1 and grows by one per accepted change (a revision that changes something, or the retirement). The same number the flow's events carry.

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor of the next page, to be passed back unchanged as `cursor`. Absent on the last page.

schema.title: ProcessFlowPage

400.description: The `all` query parameter is present but not a boolean (`invalid-query-parameter`), `limit` is not an integer from 1 to 500 (`invalid-limit`), `cursor` is not a token this API issued (`invalid-cursor`), or the request carries a query parameter this operation does not declare (`unknown-query-parameter`).

schema.description: RFC 7807 Problem Details for HTTP APIs.
schema.title: ProblemDetails

500.description: An unexpected error (problem type `internal-error`): a storage or other infrastructure failure, or a recovered panic. On `POST /process-paths` a 5xx is never stored under the Idempotency-Key, so a retry with the same key runs again.

schema.description: RFC 7807 Problem Details for HTTP APIs.
schema.title: ProblemDetails
